id: W:pereira|compendio narrativo do peregrino da america
original_title: Compêndio narrativo do peregrino da América
note: Author is Nuno Marques Pereira. ISBN identifies a modern facsimile of the early text, not the cited 1939 edition. USP catalogue https://www.brasiliana.usp.br/handle/bbm/4065 confirms the 1939 sixth edition, completed with the previously unpublished second part. No candidates supplied.

The LC title Dicionário bibliografico portuguez and cited Dicionário Bibliográfico Português name the same bibliography; the citation modernizes spelling and accents. Begun in 1858 and continued by Brito Aranha and others. Retain this LCCN; the title difference is orthographic. No candidates supplied.

id: W:menendez pidal|primera cronica general de espana
original_title: Primera crónica general de España: que mandó componer Alfonso el Sabio y se continuaba bajo Sancho IV en 1289
catalogued_as: Alfonso X, King of Castile and Leon; Menéndez Pidal, Ramón (editor)
note: LCCN identifies the cited 1955 Gredos edition, published by Ramón Menéndez Pidal with Solalinde, Muñoz Cortés and Gómez Pérez. Menéndez Pidal edited the medieval chronicle; 1906 is the first publication of his edition. None of the supplied candidates is this chronicle.

Portuguese translation of the 1997 Seuil collection edited by Jean-Pierre Rioux and Jean-François Sirinelli; JeanPierre is the truncated coeditor. LCCN and ISBN identify that original collection. It is distinct from candidate Histoire culturelle de la France and the 1998 article.

container: Historiedidaktik, edited by Christer Karlegärd and Klas-Göran Karlsson (Lund: Studentlitteratur, 1997), pp. 49–81.
note: The garbled author field preserves Jensen’s distinctive chapter subtitle followed by the volume editors, identifying his chapter confidently. ISBN belongs to the container, not the chapter; Lund’s bibliographic record verifies that container ISBN. Jensen’s own bibliography also lists the chapter: https://bernardericjensen.dk/wp-content/uploads/2012/01/HIN9_BEJ.pdf .

Virgilio is Virgil, also catalogued as Publius Vergilius Maro. ISBN identifies Conte’s 2019 Latin edition of the same Aeneid, not the unspecified 1983 translation. Composition ended about 19 BCE; the ancient date is approximate. Translator and publisher of the cited edition remain unknown.

catalogued_as: Gauvard, Claude; Libera, Alain de; Zink, Michel (editors)
note: BnF identifies the 2002 PUF Quadrige edition and ISBN, under the direction of Claude Gauvard, Alain de Libera and Michel Zink. The cited people are editors of the dictionary. No candidates supplied.

D’Araújo is catalogued without the prefix as Araújo, Maria Celina Soares; the publisher uses that name for this ISBN. This is her 2000 Zahar monograph in Descobrindo o Brasil. The apparent author mismatch is a name-form difference. No candidates supplied.

The abbreviated citation does not distinguish volume I, Porque as notícias são como são, from volume II, A tribo jornalística: uma comunidade interpretativa transnacional. The year 2008 does not uniquely determine the volume. A volume-specific ISBN would select a work without sufficient evidence.
Generic Portuguese Bible citation with no translator, version, canon or publisher. The year 2014 cannot identify one edition or a unique bibliographic work; no identifier assigned.

container: Enciclopédia Einaudi, vol. 1: Memória–História (Lisboa: Imprensa Nacional–Casa da Moeda, 1984), pp. 11–50; original entry in Enciclopedia Einaudi, vol. 8: Labirinto–Memoria (Torino: Einaudi, 1979), pp. 1068–1109.
note: Le Goff’s individual encyclopaedia entry, translated into Portuguese in 1984. ISBN identifies the Portuguese containing volume, also used for later printings, not an independently published chapter. The publisher confirms this ISBN. Do not equate the entry with the entire Storia e memoria or History and memory collections.

id: W:velho|frentes de expansao e estrutura agraria
original_title: Frentes de expansão e estrutura agrária: estudo do processo de penetração numa área da Transamazônica
note: The truncated cited author is Otávio Guilherme Velho. The publisher-platform page verifies the title, author, eISBN and DOI of the 2009 Centro Edelstein edition of the book first published by Zahar in 1972. Identifiers ground the work through this later edition. No candidates supplied.

original_title: L’histoire orale : bilan d’un quart de siècle de réflexion méthodologique et de travaux
container: Usos & abusos da história oral, edited by Marieta de Moraes Ferreira and Janaína Amado (Rio de Janeiro: FGV, first edition 1996; cited third edition 2000), pp. 43–62.
catalogued_as: Ferreira, Marieta de Moraes; Amado, Janaína (container editors)
note: Joutard’s chapter, not Ces voix qui nous viennent du passé. ISBN belongs to the Portuguese containing volume, catalogued under its editors. The French antecedent is the 1995 international historical congress report. No independently identifiable chapter DOI or publisher article page established.

original_title: Spie: radici di un paradigma indiziario
container: Mitos, emblemas, sinais: morfologia e história (São Paulo: Companhia das Letras, 1989), pp. 143–179; Portuguese translation of Miti, emblemi, spie (Torino: Einaudi, 1986), candidate w-955.
note: Individual essay contained in candidate w-955, not a translation of the whole collection. ISBN identifies the 1989 Portuguese containing book translated by Federico Carotti. The essay first appeared in Crisi della ragione (1979), pp. 57–106, and was revised for the 1986 collection.

catalogued_as: Jacobus, de Voragine; Jacopo de Varazze
note: Jacopo de Varazze is also catalogued as Jacobus de Voragine. The publisher confirms this ISBN, author and Hilário Franco Júnior’s Portuguese translation, published 24 June 2003. Medieval compilation composed around 1260; original year approximate. No candidates supplied.
